description:
Correct a lot the USER already recorded: a mistyped quantity, price, trade date or note. Only the fields you pass change; the rest are left alone.

The instrument itself cannot be edited: a lot on the wrong stock or the wrong contract is a different holding, so remove it with RemovePortfolioLot and add the right one. To record a sale, use ClosePortfolioLot rather than editing the quantity down, because editing it away loses the realized profit.

acquiredDate.description: Optional. The corrected trade date, as yyyy-MM-dd.

costPerUnit.description: Optional. The corrected price per share, always positive.

lotId.description: The lot id shown by GetMyPortfolio, e.g. a1b2c3d4.

note.description: Optional. A replacement note, up to 256 characters.

portfolio.description: The portfolio holding the lot, by name.

quantity.description: Optional. The corrected signed size. Negative is a short or written option.

name: UpdatePortfolioLot
title: Update Portfolio Lot
